fixtures.env: Misha E0 solo vs 3 Ice-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: R—Room Service! (131202) is Misha's damaging Skill action.
R—Room Service! hits the designated enemy once per cast (4 Skill casts in the fixture).
R—Room Service! is a Blast attack: 2 adjacent hits per cast × 4 casts.
G—Gonna Be Late! (131203) is Misha's Ultimate action.
The Ultimate's first hit (single-target, 60% L10) fires once per Ultimate (2 Ultimates).
The Ultimate's remaining random hits (60% L10 each) scale with Skill Points spent: 6 random hits per Ultimate in the fixture → 12 total.
Basic E—Excuse Me, Please! (131201) is available and used in the fixture.
Misha's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; it never falls back to a generic attack action.
R—Room Service! primary hit L10 = 200% of ATK (131202 #1).
R—Room Service! adjacent hit L10 = 80% of ATK (131202 #2).
The Ultimate's designated-enemy hit L10 = 60% of ATK (131203 #2 — #1 = 300% total over the base + random hits).
The Ultimate's random hits L10 = 60% of ATK each (131203 #2).
Basic E—Excuse Me, Please! totals 100% at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (ladder tops at 140%→100% at L10; observed split sums to 1.0).
Misha's Ultimate uses the 100-Energy ladder (sp_need 100); over this fixture his action set regenerates exactly 155 Energy (includes talent energy refunds).
Talent 131204 regenerates 2 Energy per Skill Point spent (canon #1 = 2 at L10); the fixture's 4 SP spends each grant the canon amount.
The Ultimate's #3 = 20% base chance to Freeze lands in the fixture (Freeze DoT applied by Misha).
Hits against Frozen targets add Additional DMG equal to #4 = 30% of Misha's ATK (0.3 × 2000 = 600) per 131203.
Bonus Ability (A2) grants Effect Hit Rate +60% while the Ultimate is active (observed as misha_a2_ehr buffStat ehr 0.6).
Bonus Ability (A3) grants CRIT DMG +30% against Frozen enemies (observed as misha_a3_cd buffStat critDmg 0.3).
Within each Ultimate, the designated-enemy first hit precedes the random-target hits (131203 resolution order).
The Freeze DoT is applied before Frozen Additional DMG events can fire against the target.
